classification_policy.CANDIDATE_PRIVATE: Implementation surface appears replaceable by the SDK public aperture; repository-local handoff/dependency review required before mutation.
classification_policy.REVIEW_REQUIRED: Purpose is mixed or insufficiently inspected; no visibility mutation is authorized yet.
